purpose: locbridge1: NMEA -> locationd bridge (gpu/hwcodec/locbridge: nmea.c + n2locbridge.c, host-tested by test_host.sh). /usr/local/libexec/n2locbridge, signed ad-hoc with com.apple.locationd.simulation (sign_ent.py, verify_sig.py), feeds every valid RMC/GGA fix to locationd via CLSimulationManager (clearSimulatedLocations/appendSimulatedLocation:/flush/startLocationSimulation). Job com.nord2.locbridge, gate /private/var/db/nord2-locbridge. First test: replay of a synthetic 20-epoch walk near Rome (sample-drive.nmea), looping, 1 fix/s. For a live source use args ['--fifo','/private/var/run/n2gnss.nmea']. Undo: guest-locbridge1-undo.sh + payload-locbridge1-undo + owned-locbridge1.json.
needs: locationd answering synchronous/simulation requests (see locdiag1); payload-locationd1 (Location Services on)
